text: Oriance's website is published by the sarl A-D Oriance (Siret 480 426 758 00037, 200 rue Robert Schuman, Guipavas). The company register lists AD INVEST (SIREN 804544914) as Président de SAS of ABGRALL-DELANOE (A.D.) (SIREN 480426758), and Stéphane Michel Abgrall and Bruno Yvon Delanoë as the gérants of AD INVEST. The club's partner page says Oriance was created in 2004 in Brest.
short: Oriance's company is chaired by the holding AD Invest, whose gérants are Stéphane Abgrall and Bruno Delanoë.
